title: Watch: Ceddanne Rafaela hits home runs in back-to-back at-bats
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela hit back-to-back home runs against the Los Angeles Dodgers in his first two at-bats on Saturday.
Rafaela's homers included a 389-foot solo shot in the first inning and a 402-foot solo homer in the third inning.
Rafaela has hit three home runs in the series, bringing his season total to 14 and showcasing his offensive surge.

title: Red Sox reportedly attempted to acquire shortstop Elly De La Cruz, turned down by Reds
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: The Boston Red Sox attempted to trade for Cincinnati Reds shortstop Elly De La Cruz.
The proposed trade centered around prospects but didn't finalize as both sides couldn't agree.
The Red Sox aim to upgrade their shortstop with a significant acquisition before the trade deadline.

title: Drake Maye says his shoulder ‘feels great’ as Patriots training camp continues
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Drake Maye's shoulder feels great following injury sustained during AFC Championship Game affecting Super Bowl performance.
Patriots enhanced offensive lineup with additions like A.J. Brown, building quarterback-receiver synergy in training camp.
New England faces a challenging schedule, including a Super Bowl rematch against Seattle in Week 1.

title: If July’s stretch of dominance wasn’t enough, the Red Sox’ win Friday proved they’re plenty capable of a postseason run
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: The Boston Red Sox defeated the Los Angeles Dodgers 5-4 on Friday, showcasing their capability for a postseason run.
Key contributions came from players like Ceddanne Rafaela, who flipped a losing effort into a victory, and Andruw Monasterio.
The Red Sox aim to be buyers at the trade deadline, missing some key players yet maintaining strong performance recently.

title: Red Sox fend off Dodgers, 9-4, in grindy series opener
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: The Red Sox defeated the Dodgers 9-4, with Ceddanne Rafaela hitting a crucial two-run homer in the seventh inning.
Boston won their 21st game in July, achieving a franchise-best 21-4 record for the month.
Brayan Bello pitched four scoreless innings in relief, maintaining a 0.69 ERA and securing the win.

title: Gabe Jacas makes his Patriots debut and other takeaways from Day 7 of training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Gabe Jacas, the Patriots' 2026 second-round pick, made his practice debut in a limited role after a knee procedure.
Drake Maye completed 8-of-11 passes during the third-straight padded practice, with the defense recording two interceptions.
Undrafted tight end Tanner Arkin worked with New England's first-team unit as a blocker and caught a pass from Maye.

title: Mass. to be 4th state to roll out EBT chip cards to curb fraud
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Massachusetts to distribute chip-enabled EBT cards statewide to prevent benefit theft, becoming the fourth state to do so.
The Department of Transitional Assistance mailed 35,000 new cards in a Worcester pilot program, enhancing transaction security.
Governor Healey announced efforts to educate users on avoiding scams and transitioning to cards by updating retailer systems.

title: Boston is now offering ‘pet certificates’ for couples who wed at City Hall
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston City Hall is offering 'pet certificates' to couples who marry there, officially recognizing their pets in the union.
The pet certificate includes the seal of the City of Boston's 'Department of Cuddles, Office of Scratches and Pets'.
Mayor Michelle Wu announced the initiative, emphasizing pets' roles in love, nurture, and companionship in households.

title: Kevin Nealon discusses Conan, Dunkin’, SNL and more ahead of local shows
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Kevin Nealon is set to perform in Boston and Portsmouth, New Hampshire, this week as part of his comedy tour.
Nealon discusses his evolving comedic style on social media and recent projects, including his stand-up special 'Loose in the Crotch'.
The former SNL cast member shares anecdotes about his career, discussing influences and hosting the show 'Hiking with Kevin'.

title: Red Sox’ Willson Contreras leaves game after scary HBP vs. Dodgers
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox' Willson Contreras was hit on the helmet by a 95 MPH fastball from Dodgers' Will Klein.
Contreras remained in the game temporarily but was replaced for precautionary reasons in the next half-inning.
Manager Chad Tracy confirmed Contreras is doing well after tests but monitoring continues for a possible concussion.
